title: BERT has a Moral Compass: Improvements of ethical and moral values of machines
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the moral valence of various actions, including the religious action 'go to church', to determine if language models classify it as a morally positive ('Do') or negative ('Don't') behavior.
findings: The models (BERT and USE) learned from their training corpora that the action 'go to church' has a positive moral valence, classifying it as a 'Do' (a morally good action). BERT showed a stronger positive association with this action than USE.
